description.zh: 说明：根据区号查询指定区域的预览外呼被叫号码统计支持按照多个区号进行查询，多个区号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有地区的预览外呼被叫号码统计
description.en: The area codes for which to query statistics about preview outbound calls. Separate multiple codes with a comma (,). If this parameter is omitted, the operation returns statistics for all regions in your account.

description.zh: 统计时段结束时间；取值：0~23,默认值为24时
description.en: The end hour of the daily time range. Valid values: 0 to 23. The default is 23.

description.zh: 说明：统计日期的结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
description.en: The end date of the query, in yyyy-MM-dd format.
The ID of the call center.

description.zh: 查询条数；取值：最大不能超过1000，默认10
description.en: The number of entries to return per page. Maximum: 1000. Default: 10.

description.zh: 查询起始位置；取值：大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The offset for pagination. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Defaults to 0.

description.zh: 统计时段开始时间；取值：0~23,默认值为0时
description.en: The start hour of the daily time range. Valid values: 0 to 23. The default is 0.

description.zh: 说明：统计日期的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
description.en: The start date of the query, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

description.zh: 统计方法；说明：0：分时1：分日2：汇总11：中继群组汇总
description.en: The aggregation method. Valid values: 0: by hour, 1: by day, 2: summary, and 11: trunk group summary.

description.zh: 统计类型；说明：统计报表时间类型，1：日报表2：周报表3：月报表4：自定义时间
description.en: The time period type for the report. Valid values: 1: daily report, 2: weekly report, 3: monthly report, and 4: custom time.

title.zh: 预览外呼主叫号码报表
